entries.source: Clear and slightly thicker than water. It froths when shaken.
entries.target: 龙涎比水更加粘稠，和水一样清澈，当你摇晃它时会有泡沫产生。

entries.source: A towering creature, made from the bones of dozens of dead bodies. It is covered by an unholy aura.
entries.target: 一个高大的生物，由数十具尸体的骨头构成。它全身围绕着邪恶的气息。

entries.source: Cloudy and thick. Only by bottling it can you prevent it from evaporating within minutes.
entries.target: 浑浊且粘稠的液体。只有把它装进瓶子里，才能防止它在几分钟内蒸发。

entries.source: A very faded note, nearly unreadable.
entries.target: 极度磨损的笔记，几乎无法阅读。
离开前往格鲁希纳克部落
引发元素爆炸，造成#VIOLET#%d#LAST#%s伤害（每回合最多一次）

entries.source: A towering creature, made from the bones of hundreds of dead bodies. It is covered by an unholy aura.
entries.target: 一个高大的生物，由数百具尸体的骨头构成。它全身围绕着邪恶的气息。

entries.source: %s exudes a corrupted gas as it dies.
You fade from sight, making you invulnerable until the beginning of your next turn.
entries.target: 你从视线中消失并无敌，直到下一回合开始。

entries.source:
Ritches are giant insects native to the arid wastes of the southern parts of the Far East.
Vicious predators, they inject corrupting diseases into their foes, and their sharp claws cut through most armours.
entries.target:
里奇是原产于远东南部干旱地区的一种巨型土著昆虫。
他们是凶残的猎食者，用锋利的爪子刺穿大部分的盔甲，将腐败的疾病注入敌人的体内。

entries.source: Looks much like any other rock, though this one was recently sentient and trying to murder you.
entries.target: 撇开最近这块石头对你的刺杀行为外，它看起来和其他石头一模一样。

entries.source: #AQUAMARINE#As %s falls all its eyes fall to the ground!
entries.target: #AQUAMARINE#当%s倒下时它的眼睛掉落在了地上。

entries.source: The farportal seems to be inactive
entries.target: 这个远古传送门关闭着
暴击时 时空溅射伤害

entries.source: Slimy, wriggling, and crackling with electricity.
entries.target: 黏滑、蠕动的尾巴，还闪着噼啪作响的电火花。

entries.source: It is a cross between a human and a bull.
entries.target: 它拥有人类和牛的特征。

entries.source: The Iron Council (Dwarven empire main city)
entries.target: 钢铁议会（矮人帝国的主城）
